label: Handmade Medium
description: Warm handcrafted media for illustration work — every item something made with hands, never a camera or a renderer.

items.name: watercolor-wash
items.text: soft watercolor washes with blooming wet-in-wet edges, pigment pooling at the borders of every shape, paper grain showing through the color
items.text_short: blooming watercolor washes

items.name: gouache-flat
items.text: matte gouache in confident flat strokes, chalky opaque color, tiny ridges of dried paint catching the light
items.text_short: flat matte gouache

items.name: paper-collage-layers
items.text: hand-cut paper collage in layered depth, torn deckle edges, tiny true shadows where each layer lifts from the one beneath
items.text_short: layered cut-paper collage

items.name: wool-felt
items.text: needle-felted wool, fuzzy fiber halos on every contour, seams and stitch dimples left proudly visible
items.text_short: needle-felted wool texture

items.name: claymation-still
items.text: hand-modeled clay with visible thumbprints and slightly imperfect symmetry, the warm depth of a stop-motion film still
items.text_short: thumbprinted claymation still

items.name: linocut-block
items.text: a hand-pulled linocut, carved gouge marks, bold black shapes and the soft blind emboss of the press in thick paper
items.text_short: hand-pulled linocut

items.name: colored-pencil-soft
items.text: layered colored pencil, waxy strokes building velvety color, highlights lifted out with an eraser
items.text_short: layered colored pencil

items.name: ink-wash-minimal
items.text: ink wash on absorbent paper, one confident dark accent, diluted grey blooms and vast breathing whites
items.text_short: minimal ink wash

items.name: pop-up-book
items.text: a paper-engineered pop-up book scene caught mid-opening, folded card layers standing up from the gutter, glue tabs just hidden
items.text_short: pop-up book paper scene

items.name: diorama-box
items.text: a handmade shadow-box diorama, painted backdrop, cotton-wool clouds hung on threads, tiny modelled props on a small wooden stage
items.text_short: shadow-box diorama

items.name: embroidery-hoop
items.text: embroidered thread art stretched in a hoop, satin-stitch color fields, french-knot texture, the linen ground showing at the edges
items.text_short: hooped embroidery art

items.name: pastel-chalk-soft
items.text: soft chalk pastel, powdery hand-blended color, strokes breaking gently over the tooth of the paper
items.text_short: soft chalk pastel

items.name: thrown-pottery
items.text: rendered as thrown and glazed pottery, wheel rings left visible under a glaze that pools thicker in every groove
items.text_short: thrown pottery, glaze pooling in the wheel rings

items.name: hand-knitted
items.text: rendered as hand knitting, stitch definition raised across every plane, cables travelling and a slight unevenness that says it was not machined
items.text_short: hand-knitted, cables travelling and honestly uneven

items.name: patchwork-quilt
items.text: rendered as a patchwork quilt, pieced blocks meeting at hand-sewn seams, wadding lofting between lines of quilting
items.text_short: patchwork quilt, wadding lofting between the stitching

items.name: macrame-knotwork
items.text: rendered as macrame knotwork, cotton cord in repeating square knots, fringed ends combed loose at the bottom
items.text_short: macrame in square knots with combed fringe

items.name: origami-folded
items.text: rendered as folded origami, crisp mountain and valley creases holding the whole form, single sheet with no cuts and paper grain showing
items.text_short: folded origami, crisp creases and no cuts

items.name: quilled-paper
items.text: rendered in paper quilling, narrow strips coiled and pinched on edge, every form built from the paper's thin profile
items.text_short: paper quilling, strips coiled and pinched on edge

items.name: kintsugi-repair
items.text: rendered as kintsugi, breakage repaired with gold-dusted lacquer so the fracture becomes the most deliberate line in the piece
items.text_short: kintsugi, the fracture repaired in gold lacquer

items.name: batik-wax-resist
items.text: rendered as batik, wax-resist lines cracking into fine veins, dye taken unevenly where the wax gave way
items.text_short: batik with wax-resist crackle veining the dye

items.name: block-printed
items.text: rendered as hand block printing, the register drifting slightly between repeats and ink heavier where the block was pressed hardest
items.text_short: hand block print, register drifting between repeats

items.name: carved-wood
items.text: rendered as wood carving, gouge facets left unsanded and catching light, grain running through the form and deciding its detail
items.text_short: wood carving, gouge facets left unsanded

items.name: tooled-leather
items.text: rendered as tooled leatherwork, patterns beaten in with stamps and the surface burnished dark where the tool bore down
items.text_short: tooled leatherwork burnished dark at the stamp lines

items.name: woven-basketry
items.text: rendered as woven basketry, willow rods alternating over and under a rigid frame, ends trimmed at an angle
items.text_short: woven willow basketry over a rigid frame

items.name: hand-bound-book
items.text: rendered as hand bookbinding, exposed coptic stitching along the spine, boards covered in cloth with a paper label set slightly crooked
items.text_short: hand bookbinding, coptic stitching exposed

items.name: tie-dye
items.text: rendered as tie dye, fabric bound and dipped so colour bleeds outward in concentric rings, every repeat slightly different
items.text_short: tie dye bleeding outward in concentric rings

items.name: fused-glass
items.text: rendered as glass fusing, layered coloured sheets slumped together in the kiln, edges rounded and bubbles frozen inside the body
items.text_short: glass fusing, bubbles frozen inside rounded edges

items.name: whittled-wood
items.text: rendered as whittling, a single small blade working a stick down, facets left broad and the wood pale where it has just been cut
items.text_short: whittled with one blade, facets left broad

items.name: chased-metal
items.text: rendered as metal chasing, the design punched in from the front with the reverse repoussed out, hammer marks left as texture
items.text_short: chased metal, hammer marks left as texture

items.name: poured-candle
items.text: rendered as candlemaking, wax poured in layers that show at the edge, wick set true and the surface dipped once for a clean skin
items.text_short: candlemaking, poured layers showing at the edge
